items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: The last time I seen him was with Louis. He was managing a big hotel in Sacramento, and we played for him.

ctx.x: It started way before that. It was in the heyday, say, like 1923 or '24. See, but only White people patronized the Cotton Club.
But this Frank Sebastian guy, he was from here?

I presume he was. A real handsome guy. I recently... The last time I seen him was with Louis. He was managing a big hotel in Sacramento, and we played for him. And he had a club in this hotel. Town and Country I believe was the name of it.
